temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been hiding something important and says he is in trouble; he did not tell Christian because he did not want to worry him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from Christian, has been acting differently, and may be untrustworthy or evasive.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan's evasiveness is confirmed as concealment, but the reason is that Jonathan is in trouble rather than simply betraying Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been hiding something important because he is in some kind of trouble and did not know how to tell Christian.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious, shifting toward concern and shock.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Learn more about Jonathan's trouble and decide how to respond.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, initially does not want to drag Christian into it, but eventually admits he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in trouble and has been hiding something important; Christian wants to uncover the truth.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Jonathan's trouble is serious and complicated, and he is willing to accept Christian's help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious, complicated trouble; he needs support and resources, and Christian can help him face it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer help and support Jonathan, and help him figure a way out of his trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian asks if the trouble is illegal. Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, may have gotten involved with the wrong people, but insists he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious trouble that may be related to criminal activity; Christian feels conflicted and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian's suspicion of criminal involvement is refined into concern that Jonathan may be entangled with dangerous or wrong people, though Jonathan denies personal illegal conduct.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may have become involved with the wrong people, but he claims innocence; Christian does not yet know the full truth and must investigate carefully.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Investigate discreetly to find out the truth and ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian learns from his investigation that Jonathan is being framed and that someone is trying to set him up; Christian has leads but does not yet know who is responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with wrong people and needs discreet investigation; Christian suspects possible criminal entanglement but not Jonathan's guilt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the investigation shifts Christian's belief from possible criminal involvement to Jonathan being an innocent victim of a frame-up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed and is innocent; someone is trying to set him up, and Christian can help prove it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Determined, protective, and possibly angry or relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Gather more evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian determines that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan, someone they both know and trust.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person; Christian is gathering evidence to prove his innocence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Christian identifies the framer as a trusted mutual acquaintance, changing the threat from unknown to personal betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is responsible for framing Jonathan; this person has betrayed them.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Confront the real culprit and bring them to justice, making sure the betrayal does not go unpunished while being careful because the person is dangerous.
